Maria (Sales): Hey team — Acme Bank SIG is asking for evidence for Q23 (encryption at rest) + key management details. Customer deadline is Friday EOD. Anyone can own gathering the artifacts?
Dan - SE: I can pull infra artifacts. Quick q: is this for Hosted or Dedicated? Hosted = we provide cloud-KMS screenshots; Dedicated/Private = customer-managed keys or HSM screenshots. @Jules can confirm what we can share externally.
Jules - Security: They want HSM-backed key proof, rotation cadence, separation of duties. We have a KB (internal): https://internal/docs/security/kms-rotation and artifacts: rotation_policy.pdf, kms-audit-2025-01.csv. I can export key policy JSONs and a redacted key-usage report. Need approval to share rotation_policy.pdf externally (some internal contact emails need redaction).
Maria (Sales): This is Hosted (EU region) — customer will be on Hosted API but wants EU residency. They still expect SaaS KMS evidence.
Eva - Solutions: I'll assemble an evidence map for each SIG question. Proposed columns: question_id | short_answer | artifact_name | path | shareable? Example row: Q23 | Yes — AES-256 (envelope encryption) | rotation_policy.pdf | s3://redwood-evidence/acme/177777/rotation_policy.pdf | yes (redacted). I can create the folder and pre-signed links.
Dan - SE: If you paste the exact SIG question text I’ll draft an answer that matches our security wording and add the architecture snippet. Note: Hosted uses cloud KMS with HSM-backed keys + envelope encryption; we should avoid saying "customer HSM" for Hosted. Also will attach diag_kms_flow.png and keystore_policy.json (redacted).
Jules - Security: Approved to share rotation_policy.pdf after redaction. I'll produce: rotation_policy_redacted.pdf and key_usage_export_redacted.csv. For HSM wording propose: "Cryptographic keys are stored and managed in cloud KMS (FIPS 140-2 Level 3 / HSM-backed), with envelope encryption applied to customer data. Key encryption keys (KEKs) are rotated every 90 days; data encryption keys (DEKs) are rotated annually." Need sign-off from Dan on the phrasing.
Maria (Sales): :thumbsup: That phrasing looks good. I'll include a short note to the customer clarifying Hosted vs Dedicated options. Dan — please paste your drafted answer here so I can send it.
Dan - SE: Draft answer below (feel free to tweak):
```
Q23: Encryption at rest — We use envelope encryption: customer data is encrypted with data encryption keys (DEKs), which are themselves encrypted by key encryption keys (KEKs) managed in cloud KMS. The cloud KMS offering is HSM-backed. KEKs are rotated every 90 days; DEKs are rotated annually. Access to key management operations is limited by role-based access controls and audited via key-usage logs. Artifacts: rotation_policy_redacted.pdf, key_usage_export_redacted.csv, diag_kms_flow.png.
```
Jules - Security: Minor edit: add "audited via immutable logs retained for 1 year" — otherwise good.
Dan - SE: Updated.
Maria (Sales): I'm going to send this to Acme Bank with the artifacts. Will note that artifact access link expires in 7 days and include contact for follow-up call.

Maria (Sales): Thanks team — I'm sending now and will add a follow-up call Wednesday. Closing this thread once customer confirms receipt. :pray:
